# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston (or the United States)  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy and student  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric is described as a handsome, manly young boy who closely resembles his father. He wears an elegant small fur cap and coat during winter visits.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)_

## Personality

Cedric is imaginative, dream-prone, and creative, keeping an inner world of imaginary 'rock people' and 'dream-people.' Despite his whimsical mind, he possesses great manliness, holds his own in games, and is comfortable and candid around others. He holds high ethical standards, refusing to associate with those who use coarse language. While typical boys dislike affection, he will warmly offer kisses to those who remind him of his mother's loving gaze.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and fond of pretending  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P22](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0022)</sub>
- Manly and athletic  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at physical games and fighting  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
- Creative letter writing and storytelling  <sub>[v2 c11 P39](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0039), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 c11 P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)</sub>

## Goals

- To find understanding companions who comprehend his imaginative visions  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)</sub>

## History

Cedric moved from Boston to reside with his grandmother, Mrs. Stanhope, along the shore road in Brierley. At school, he became a beloved student of Nell Harcourt, excelling at games and earning the respect of his peers after engaging in a fight with St. Clair Trask over a patriotic debate. Having few real local companions by the beach, Cedric invented elaborate imaginary stone figures and adventures by the sea. Nell introduced him to Miss Rosalind Penrose at the stone house, where his resemblance to his father and his polite, endearing demeanor earned him Miss Rosalind's deep affection and friendship.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c23 P29](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0029), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)_
